title.zh: 英伟达开源 Bolt E4B：8GB 内存设备同时运行视觉与对话模型
title.en: 英伟达开源 Bolt E4B：8GB 内存设备同时运行视觉与对话模型

current_state.zh: Nvidia open-sourced Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B, a compact model trained from Google Gemma 4 E4B for local voice, game-character, and robotics use, and demonstrated it alongside Cosmos 3 Edge running both models on an 8GB Jetson Orin Nano.
current_state.en: Nvidia open-sourced Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B, a compact model trained from Google Gemma 4 E4B for local voice, game-character, and robotics use, and demonstrated it alongside Cosmos 3 Edge running both models on an 8GB Jetson Orin Nano.
